correctness.rationale: The implication from universal depth-one witnessability to Diamond p is immediate. If a positive row grade set has a nonempty subset without a maximum, a Boolean assignment marking exactly the worlds with weights in that subset makes the Diamond p supremum unattained. Conversely, every modal-free formula has Boolean value under Boolean atoms and Gödel connectives; every Box contribution is therefore 0 or 1 and every positive Diamond contribution is a positive row grade, so the reverse-well-order property attains each extremum. The countable depth-two construction has root edges of grade 1 and branch edges of grade \(1/(n+1)\); every positive row is singleton while the root Box Diamond p infimum is 0 and is nowhere attained. Double negation checks give the displayed witness axiom value 0. Exact rational program verify.py was replayed on nine finite truncations; its finite checks are not offered as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source formulates witnessedness and studies a witnessed-model logic with finite-model property, rather than a characterization of arbitrary frames guaranteeing one-step witnesses under all Boolean atomic valuations. The 2025 source uses crisp accessibility, which has different behavior at nested modalities with Boolean atoms. The 2022 source studies a two-component paraconsistent semantics and finite-branching criteria. Their inspected principal definitions, examples, and stated main results neither assert nor imply this exact graded-spectrum criterion plus the uniform-grade-depth-two obstruction. Searches for aliases including row-grade sup attainment, reverse well ordering, fuzzy modal depth two, and Boolean-valuation witnessability did not disclose coverage. This supports a provisional self-review, not a completeness proof for the literature.

value.rationale: The 2026 witnessed Gödel modal semantics creates a natural gap between assumptions on accessibility edges and actual attainment of the suprema/infima. This theorem identifies the exact obstruction at the first modal level from a single atom, rather than imposing finite branching. It then exhibits the first modal depth where this complete local criterion ceases to suffice, even for an acyclic height-two frame with one positive grade per row. This distinguishes local accessibility diversity from compositional propagation of graded truth values and exhibits failure of a characteristic witness axiom under Boolean atomic inputs. The depth bound is sharp, and the example has substantive interpretation beyond numerical testing.
